iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

MR::release
       Releases the data collected via MR::collect iRule command.

SYNOPSIS
       MR::release

DESCRIPTION
       Releases the payload data collected via MR::collect iRule command for further processing.

       This command is valid only when MR::collect has been called.

       Syntax

       MR::release
	   Releases the payload data collected via MQTT::collect for further processing.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       MR_DATA

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
